references.name: Fresh campaign first wave is achievable
references.source: Current fixed-300-ATP reference uses fifteen baseline Neutrophils at 20 ATP each. Frozen R5 regression clears 8 of 9 reused paid-script seeds, with 3–100 integrity among clears and a valid seed-404 defeat. The older 9/9 at 53–93 integrity is historical pre-spawn-guard evidence. Automatic R5 regression clears 16/16 with ordinary income; these are controller regressions, not fresh independent qualification.

evidence.role: Fixed paid scripted feasibility, including retained failure; automatic controller evidence is reported separately.

current_runtime_regression.scope: Previously used seeds; no new independent qualification. Paid and automatic evidence have different reinforcement budgets.
